Name: Kawaii Kitchen
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
Replaces your kitchen with a cuter version (choose from pink, blue or purple) and adds furniture to decorate your new kitchen!

(How to change color: Go into the config.json in the Content Patcher folder and change the color to either pink, blue or purple)

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/V93CvTp.png[/img]
1. download and install content patcher and furniture framework
2. download this mod
3. unzip contents into stardew's mod folder

[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ furniture can be bought from Robin
♡ I used the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] mod to center the furniture in the pictures, highly recommend~
♡ sprites made by me
